decisions.ownership: Airbrush owns generic technique, equipment, colors, maintenance and practice. Model-specific application intents belong to Airbrush-Modellbau; the Airbrush hub links to them instead of duplicating them.

Owns the end-to-end bean-to-bar process from cocoa raw material through roasting, refining, recipe development and finished bars. Generic chocolate/praline intents remain separate owners; bean-to-bar pages must keep explicit process context.
Owns the generic 3D-printing orientation intent. Resin-3D-Druck, 3D-Scanning and CAD keep their own canonical identities and specific intents; a future FDM unit requires its own assessment.

Owns the generic amateur-astronomy orientation intent. Teleskop-Astronomie, Astrofotografie, Sonnenbeobachtung, Radioastronomie, Meteorbeobachtung and other concrete disciplines own their specific intents.

Owns aeroponics-specific systems, misting/nozzles, root chamber, aeroponic nutrient/water management and aeroponic plant operation. Generic hydroponics, hydroculture and indoor-growing intents stay with those identities.

Owns ant husbandry, species, colony care, feeding, winter rest, climate and operational formicarium use. Construction-focused DIY intents belong to Formicarienbau; generic terrarium intents remain outside.

Owns 3D-parcours, 3D targets/scoring, terrain shooting, unknown-distance practice and equipment choices explicitly in 3D context. Generic archery basics/equipment belong to Bogenschießen; traditional-style intents belong to traditionelles Bogenschießen.
Owns collecting, identifying, valuing, preserving and restoring old/vintage board games. Generic board-game play/reviews do not belong here.

Owns Wabi-Kusa balls/containers, substrate, emersed aquatic-plant arrangements and their humidity/light/care. Aquascaping owns submerged aquarium layouts; Kokedama and Kusamono remain distinct plant practices.
Owns bookbinding craft, materials, tools and binding techniques. Course/provider/service intents belong to DIRECTORY and do not count as CORE article ownership.
Owns the generic filting orientation intent. Nadelfilzen and Nassfilzen keep separate canonical identities and specific practice intents.
Owns finding, selecting, cleaning, drying, storing and lawful collecting of driftwood. Related natural finds keep their own identities.
Owns air-dry-clay-specific handling, drying, crack prevention, sanding, painting, sealing and repair. Polymer Clay and Cold Porcelain remain separate identities.
Owns model-specific airbrush application intents. Generic Airbrush technique/equipment stays with the Airbrush hub; no duplicate generic Airbrush hub is created.
Owns alabaster-specific material selection, shaping, sanding, polishing and safety. Generic carving and other stone materials stay with their own identities.
Owns active microalgae/algae cultivation practice. Observation/microscopy intents remain with Planktonbeobachtung and Gewässermikroskopie.
Owns generic amateur-radio orientation and overview. Concrete modes/subdisciplines such as Morsefunk, Satellitenfunk and Amateur Radio Direction Finding keep their own specific intents.
Owns license-free CB-radio equipment, setup, antennas, operating practice and CB-specific communication. Amateur-radio licensing/modes remain with Amateurfunk.
Owns SDR hardware/software, receivers, decoding and SDR-specific projects. Specific radio services/communities keep their own operating intents.

Owns active radio communication via satellites, especially amateur-satellite operating practice. Receive-only satellite reception stays with Satellitenempfang; orbital tracking stays with Satellitentracking.

Owns receive-only satellite signals, antennas/receivers, decoding and reception practice. Two-way satellite radio belongs to Satellitenfunk; pure tracking/orbit observation belongs to Satellitentracking.
Owns receiving, tracking, predicting and recovering radiosondes/weather balloons. Generic SDR remains an enabling tool, not the primary owner.
Owns general radio-direction-finding equipment, bearings, triangulation and practical fox-hunt style exercises. Amateur Radio Direction Finding keeps the formal competitive-sport intent.
Owns Morse/CW-specific learning and operating content. Generic amateur-radio setup/licensing remains with Amateurfunk.
Owns generic electronics-project orientation. Mikrocontroller-Projekte, Arduino, Raspberry-Pi-Projekte, Synthesizerbau, Effektpedale and other concrete practices keep their specific intents.
Owns platform-neutral microcontroller fundamentals, sensors/actuators, power, buses and embedded projects. Arduino-specific platform content stays with Arduino.
Owns Arduino boards, IDE/toolchain, libraries, shields and Arduino-specific projects. Generic embedded concepts remain with Mikrocontroller-Projekte.
Owns Raspberry-Pi-specific setup, Linux/GPIO, networking and maker projects. Generic microcontroller content stays separate.
Owns generic hobby-robotics orientation. Roboterbau, Heimrobotik and Kampfroboterbau keep their concrete intents.
Owns domestic/home-robot application content. Generic construction belongs to Roboterbau; broad robot technology belongs to Robotik.
Owns designing/building hobby robots, chassis, drives, sensors, controllers and integration. Application niches keep their own specific intents.

Owns generic hobby combat-robot building, drive/weapon systems, armor, safety and non-brand-specific competition preparation. The BattleBots name is reserved for official BattleBots events/shows/products and is not used as generic SEO owner.
decisions.external_evidence: BattleBots Inc. states BattleBots is an exclusive trademark and asks that the name not be used unless referring to official BattleBots events, shows or products.
